source_text: In contrast, Orthodox Judaism categorically rejects Brit Shalom as a substitute for brit milah, maintaining that Genesis 17:10-14 mandates physical circumcision for covenantal inclusion, rendering uncircumcised males ineligible for full ritual participation until adulthood.
